title: 夜鷹 Nighthawk
caption: Cool jazz quartet instrumental, late-night and noir. Muted trumpet lead with a harmon mute, walking upright bass, light swinging ride cymbal and brushes, understated piano comping, a short piano solo. Cool, detached, a detective walking empty streets. Warm vintage analog recording with room ambience. No vocals.
note: Preferred in the listening test (configuration B).
